# BillDash

> BillDash is 100% free POS billing software (Android app) for restaurants, cafés, bakeries, tiffin centres, juice shops, cloud kitchens and other food businesses in India. Made by Ncaps Infotech, Bengaluru.

## Key facts
- Price: free (no limit on bills or products); optional BillDash Pro subscription removes ads and adds automatic Google Drive backups
- Platform: Android phones and tablets — Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ncaps.billdash
- Billing: tap-to-bill menu, quantities, parcel charges (per item or per bill), flat discounts, round-off
- Payments: cash (with automatic change calculation), UPI and card
- GST: price inclusive or exclusive of GST per item; 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% slabs; GSTIN on receipts
- Printing: Bluetooth thermal receipt printers (58 mm, 80 mm, 100 mm), auto-print after payment, Android system printing, share bill as PDF
- Reports: sales by day/week/month/custom range, bill count, average bill, payment split, profit (sales minus expenses), bill history with search, cancel/repeat bills
- Expenses: category-wise expense tracking (vegetables, milk, gas, rent, salary, etc.)
- Data: stored on the device; free backup to the user's own Google Drive and restore; CSV and PDF export
- Support: WhatsApp +91 80508 58538
